mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses discount rates for equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy remains accommodative.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 7.0% for three consecutive months signals labor market weakness prompting central bank intervention, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as policy support is anticipated.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 7.0% for 3 months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 in any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad consumer demand contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as recession risks escalate.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline for 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL above 3.0% annually) forces monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as bond yields rise and equity valuations contract.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.0% annually, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained non-farm payrolls growth above 100,000 per month strengthens labor market conditions, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings to drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of months when PAYEMS growth exceeds 100,000, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 in any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production falling below 100 for two consecutive months indicates manufacturing contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as economic slowdown risks increase.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO < 100 for 2 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in real GDP (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) signal severe aggregate demand deterioration, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as recession fears intensify.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both GDPC1 and HOUST decline for 3 months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 7.0%), declining unemployment signals labor market improvement, boosting consumer confidence and corporate profits to generate positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 7.0% and declining, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year window.
